text: The educator direction brings together craft, identity and responsible artificial intelligence.
Start with one skill that a learner can demonstrate.
Model it, guide practice and ask the learner to explain the decision.
Then review a prepared bilingual draft.
Check the facts, the meaning and the promises before using it.
No real client details are needed.
The result is a micro-lesson and a corrected example.
The educator keeps responsibility for the final words and the professional standard.
